paths.purpose: Keep a request ambiguous after a possible delivery even when the retry connection is refused; expose the stable request identity for readback and safe replay.
Cover pre-send service unavailability, post-send restart ambiguity, and retry with one stable request identity.

steps: enter an authenticated Environment session through the Control RPC
publish one checkpoint, then stop the test RPC service after dispatch and before response delivery
confirm the caller reports publication-outcome-ambiguous with the original request identity
start a new RPC service instance over the same isolated Store and issue a fresh execution grant
retry the identical checkpoint request with the original identity
inspect from a fresh protected process and confirm exactly one checkpoint identity

validation.environment_command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_environment.py -k 'rpc_client_keeps_restart_window or rpc_client_reports_first_connect or rpc_client_retries_after_disconnect or rpc_client_maps_claim_conflicts or checkpoint_request_retry_reads_back_one_immutable_checkpoint' --tb=short
validation.control_result: passed; Bwrap child ran in project scope
validation.static_checks: git diff --check and python3 -m compileall -q src tests/test_sandbox_terminal.py passed

related_canonical_service_evidence.limitation: that canonical restart followed a completed publication response; it does not prove service loss between commit and response

canonical_store_status.remaining_acceptance: Run a commit-before-response interruption against the deployed owner service and canonical Store when the service can be safely interrupted; retain the existing separate canonical caller-interruption and same-request replay proofs.
